Supercharge Your Productivity with Tasks.org: To-Do List & Tasks

Searching for the perfect "tasks" app? Look no further! Tasks.org is the open-source, privacy-focused to-do list and task management solution designed to streamline your life.  Take control of your schedule with powerful features, seamless synchronization, and a completely customizable experience.

Effortless Task Management:

• Conquer Complex Projects: Organize your tasks with nested, collapsible subtasks of unlimited depth.  Break down large projects into manageable steps and stay on top of every detail.
• Seamless Synchronization:  Sync with Tasks.org Cloud, Google Tasks, DAVx⁵, Microsoft To Do, CalDAV, EteSync, and DecSync CC, or work completely offline. Your tasks are always accessible, wherever you are.
• Intuitive Drag & Drop: Prioritize your tasks with easy drag-and-drop sorting, compatible with Nextcloud Tasks and Apple Reminders.
• Powerful Recurring Tasks:  Automate repetitive tasks with flexible and customizable recurrence options.
• Tasks.org Cloud: Share lists with Friends & Family and instantly turn your emails into tasks with a dedicated email address.

Privacy You Can Trust:

Tasks.org respects your privacy.  Enjoy an ad-free experience with no ad or location tracking. You're in control of your data.

Key Features for Mastering Your Tasks:

• Location-Based Reminders: Set reminders based on arrival or departure from specific locations.
• Powerful Filtering & Search: Quickly find the tasks you need with robust filtering and search capabilities.
• Customizable Widgets: Access your tasks at a glance with highly customizable widgets.
• Beautiful & Personalized:  Customize your lists with icons and colors to match your style.
• Automatic Backups: Secure your data with automatic backups to internal storage, Google Drive, and the Android Backup Service.
• Integrations: Connect with Tasker for automated task creation and list reminders.
• Wear OS Support: Manage your tasks on the go with our Wear OS app, featuring watch face complications so you can check your tasks with a flick of the wrist.

Join the Tasks.org Community:

• Website: tasks.org
• Reddit: r/tasks
• X: @tasks_org
• Email: play-support@tasks.org

Download Tasks.org today and experience the power of open-source task management!  Take control of your to-do list, manage your tasks effectively, and reclaim your productivity.
